verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST Jobs API, a published OpenAPI spec, an MCP server, an x402 API, a ClawHub skill, and Zapier/Google integrations, but no official SDK or client library in any language. An OpenAPI spec and an MCP server are adjacent building blocks or different surfaces, not SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
